name: profile_power_cycle
description: All eight profiles survive a power cycle: the device starts in the profile it was told to, with the bindings, macros and routes that profile carries.
requires: A keyboard and a mouse attached

steps.note: eight distinct profiles: different routes, bindings and macros
one event per binding in this profile

checks.active_profile_survives_power_cycle: each of the eight profiles came back active
checks.bindings_match_profile: every binding behaved as that profile defines it
checks.routes_match_profile: keyboard and mouse routes matched the profile after every restart
